verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace, and a buyer could fairly ask any cloud or compute provider whether customer data is used for model training, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no training opt-out, data-use policy, or no-training commitment. Pod volume encryption at rest is a related security control and does not address training use of data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
